tracks.note: Kernel submissions close Nov 4 at 11:59 pm PT. The serving track opens Nov 10 at 9 am PT.

latest_update:
### 2026-11-03 15:45 PT

The serving track now opens Nov 10 at 9 am PT. It still closes Nov 19 at 11:59 pm PT.

We've received more than 300,000 submissions to the kernel track. It's been great to see the engagement, and we want to
take the time to review submissions properly before the next track opens. We're also updating the [serving
rules](https://openkernelchallenge.dev/rules#serving) based on what we've seen in the kernel track.

Many of the kernel submissions run to more than 10,000 lines of code and include separate variants specifically for the
tested shapes. For the serving track in particular, we want to encourage code that SGLang maintainers could actually
accept. We'll consult them on the top patches, and their judgment of whether a patch could be merged will be a factor in
our choice of final winners.

The live leaderboard also over-incentivizes fitting to the judge, even with daily auto-reviewing and explicit guidance
on the spirit of the competition, so the serving leaderboard will stay private until the track is over. You'll still see
your own scores.
note: No schedule change from prior verification. Prefill is also available; this observation does not establish its weight in overall ranking.
